scenarios.name: Show and hides a ribbon panel from its title context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the Sketch ribbon's Layout panel is hidden
the user opens Show Panels from the Create panel title context menu
Layout is listed as unchecked in the panel visibility submenu
the Layout panel appears on the Sketch ribbon
Make Part and Make Components are unavailable
the user opens Show Panels from the Create panel title context menu
the Layout panel is hidden from the Sketch ribbon
the sketch remains active and unchanged
